“Liberian Girl” by Michael Jackson
Listen to Michael Jackson: https://MichaelJackson.lnk.to/_listenYD

“Liberian Girl” is the eighth of nine short films for the “Bad” album and features three dozen actors, musicians and celebrities in a humorous “behind-the-scenes” look at the set of a Michael Jackson short film as everyone awaits Michael’s arrival. snippet.title: Princess Diana's most colourful acts
snippet.description: Princess Diana's most colourful acts. When AIDS was still an unknown and therefore frightening disease, Diana, visiting a hospital, shook the hand of a sick person without gloves, showing everyone that the disease is not transmitted through touch. Advocating the banning of landmines, she visited Angola where, after meeting with victims, she walked through a strip of minefield that had not been fully cleared. And on sports day at Wetherby School, where her sons attended, the Princess didn't hide behind her title and took part in a mother's race. The photo of a sleeping Diana, taken at a ball in the museum, became a real sensation. The press was outraged until it became known that Diana was already pregnant with William. In 1992, the princess visited India, where she visited a leprosarium, and again shocked the world by touching the feet of a leprosy patient.

snippet.title: EL ERROR DE MICHAEL JACKSON CON LA PRINCESA DIANA
snippet.description:
En la vida real hay protocolos reales tan estrictos que nadie en el mundo se atrevería a romper, pero cuando el Rey del Pop y la princesa de corazones se encontraron por primera vez frente a frente, un pequeño descuido físico rompió todas las reglas de la corona británica.

En este Short hablamos del mítico y prohibido encuentro entre Michael Jackson y la princesa Diana en 1988, y los celos que provocó en el príncipe Carlos. 👑🇬🇧

En este video verás:

📜 El estricto protocolo real que prohíbe tocar a un miembro de la realeza sin permiso.

🤝 El momento exacto en que Michael Jackson rompe la regla al sujetar el brazo de Diana.

👀 La incómoda reacción y la mirada del príncipe Carlos al notar el contacto físico.

🤫 El secreto que Diana le susurró a Michael al oído desafiando las órdenes de su esposo.

Durante la famosa gira del álbum Bad en el estadio de Wembley, la princesa Diana y el príncipe Carlos asistieron al concierto. Antes de salir al escenario, Michael se reunió con ellos y, por la emoción del momento, rompió el protocolo al tocar accidentalmente el brazo de Diana. El príncipe Carlos los observó de inmediato con profunda seriedad, interrumpiendo para preguntar de qué hablaban. Lo que Carlos no sabía es que Diana le estaba rogando en secreto a Michael que cantara Dirty Diana, su canción favorita. Aunque el cantante la había eliminado del show por puro respeto a su título real, la propia princesa le dio el permiso definitivo para hacer vibrar el estadio.

Prepárate para ver ese momento con otros ojos.

snippet.title: Princess Diana’s dance for Charles
snippet.description: Princess Diana's gift that shocked and angered Prince Charles. In 1985, Diana decided to surprise her husband in honor of his 37th birthday. That evening, the couple arrived at a charity event at the Royal Opera House in London. While the prince watched the performance, Diana quietly slipped out of the royal box to give a special gift to her husband, namely, to perform a dance with the famous ballet dancer Wayne Slip. And so Wayne and Diana appeared in front of the audience, dressed in a white combination dress. The audience went wild. All 2,500 people were at a loss for words. "Just don't drop the future Queen of England," Wayne worried. He feared that Diana was too tall for him - the difference in their height was 23 centimeters. The audience gave her a standing ovation, but Charles' sour expression showed that he was not satisfied. After the performance, he told her that she had once again drawn the audience's attention to herself.

snippet.title: Michael Jackson Broke Royal Protocol by Touching Princess Diana 💀
snippet.description:
🇬🇧 English:
Michael Jackson met Princess Diana and Prince Charles backstage at Wembley Stadium in 1988. While showing them his albums, Charles began asking Michael questions. During the conversation, Michael gently touched Princess Diana’s arm — and her instant reaction made the moment unforgettable. 👀😭

🇷🇺 Русский:
Майкл Джексон встретился с принцессой Дианой и принцем Чарльзом за кулисами стадиона «Уэмбли» в 1988 году. Пока Майкл показывал им свои альбомы, Чарльз начал задавать ему вопросы. Во время разговора Майкл слегка коснулся руки принцессы Дианы — и её мгновенная реакция сделала этот момент незабываемым. 👀😭

🇰🇷 한국어:
마이클 잭슨은 1988년 웸블리 스타디움 백스테이지에서 다이애나 왕세자비와 찰스 왕세자를 만났습니다. 마이클이 자신의 앨범을 보여주던 중 찰스가 그에게 질문을 하기 시작했습니다. 대화 도중 마이클이 다이애나의 팔을 살짝 건드렸고, 그녀의 즉각적인 반응이 눈길을 끌었습니다. 👀😭

🇫🇷 Français:
Michael Jackson a rencontré la princesse Diana et le prince Charles dans les coulisses du stade de Wembley en 1988. Alors qu’il leur montrait ses albums, Charles a commencé à poser des questions à Michael. Pendant la conversation, Michael a doucement touché le bras de Diana — et sa réaction immédiate a rendu ce moment inoubliable. 👀😭

🇩🇪 Deutsch:
Michael Jackson traf Prinzessin Diana und Prinz Charles 1988 hinter den Kulissen des Wembley-Stadions. Während Michael ihnen seine Alben zeigte, begann Charles, ihm Fragen zu stellen. Während des Gesprächs berührte Michael sanft Dianas Arm — und ihre sofortige Reaktion machte diesen Moment unvergesslich. 👀😭

🇸🇦 العربية:
التقى مايكل جاكسون بالأميرة ديانا والأمير تشارلز خلف كواليس ملعب ويمبلي عام 1988. وبينما كان مايكل يعرض عليهما ألبوماته، بدأ تشارلز بطرح الأسئلة عليه. وخلال الحديث، لمس مايكل ذراع الأميرة ديانا بلطف — وكانت ردة فعلها الفورية لافتة للنظر. 👀😭

🇺🇿 O‘zbekcha:
Maykl Jekson 1988-yilda Wembley stadionida sahna ortida malika Diana va shahzoda Charlz bilan uchrashdi. Maykl ularga albomlarini ko‘rsatayotgan paytda Charlz unga savollar bera boshladi. Suhbat davomida Maykl Diananing qo‘liga muloyimlik bilan tegdi — uning darhol bergan reaksiyasi esa bu lahzani unutilmas qildi. 👀😭

🇪🇸 Español:
Michael Jackson conoció a la princesa Diana y al príncipe Carlos detrás del escenario del estadio de Wembley en 1988. Mientras Michael les mostraba sus álbumes, Carlos comenzó a hacerle preguntas. Durante la conversación, Michael tocó suavemente el brazo de Diana — y su reacción inmediata hizo que el momento fuera inolvidable. 👀😭

🇮🇹 Italiano:
Michael Jackson incontrò la principessa Diana e il principe Carlo nel backstage dello stadio di Wembley nel 1988. Mentre Michael mostrava loro i suoi album, Carlo iniziò a fargli alcune domande. Durante la conversazione, Michael toccò delicatamente il braccio di Diana — e la sua reazione immediata rese il momento indimenticabile. 👀😭

snippet.title: Donald Trump and Princess Diana
snippet.description: Donald Trump and Princess Diana met in 1995 at a charity dinner in New York. Diana immediately charmed him. Six months later, Donald sent the princess a bouquet of flowers on her 35th birthday. Then made a donation to one of the organisations that Diana supervised. The amount was such that the princess wrote him a letter thanking him. In response to the letter, and despite the fact that Trump was married to Marla Maples and Diana was still married to Charles, Donald sent flowers again with a note expressing his not-so-sincere sympathy for her divorce. Diana then began receiving expensive flowers on a regular basis, she began to fear that Donald was stalking her. She once expressed that Trump gave her "goosebumps." After Diane's death in 1997, Trump expressed "tremendous regret" that he didn't have an affair with her. And in his book, he wrote: "I couldn't help but notice the effect she had on people.She filled the whole room with her presence, her charm. She was a real princess - the lady of dreams."
